purpose: Read-only city parcel-source discovery; no runtime, global, catalog, or registry integration.
assessment: The anonymous city map page’s embedded layer list does not contain a cadastral parcel/City Survey Plot layer; the public WMS has survey/revenue boundary styling layers but no parcel feature layer. AppData.js points to a separate survey portal at /ascdl_survey, which returns HTTP 401 without credentials. The generic GeoJSON POST accepts WKT and a layer table name but provides no safe field allowlist/result cap; no unauthenticated layer/geometry request was made.
registryAssessment: The official municipal Smart City GIS describes city-wide digitized cadastral maps, and the district administration links a property-card service; the official Gazette confirms that the former Aurangabad city name refers to current Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar.

searchQueries.query: Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar formerly Aurangabad official city cadastral GIS property parcel land records map
searchQueries.result: The city Smart City GIS portal states that mapping covered the entire 170 sq km city and that cadastral maps were digitized; the map exposes 100+ layers. The district portal links a property-card service. Maharashtra Gazette notification dated 24 Feb 2023 officially changes the city name from Aurangabad to Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, supporting this WUP identity. No anonymous full-polygon response was verified.
searchQueries.method: Separate English web search and inspection of first-party city GIS, district property-card service, and published Maharashtra Gazette notification.

searchQueries.method: Separate Marathi-language search and inspection of local government GIS/land-record pages.

portals.name: Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar Smart City GIS
portals.operator: Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar Smart City Development Corporation Limited (jointly owned by Government of Maharashtra and municipal corporation)
portals.observation: City Smart GIS overview documents digitized cadastral maps, but its live public layer list exposes no cadastral/parcel layer. Its WMS exposes survey-boundary styling layers but not parcel features; the configured separate survey portal returns HTTP 401 anonymously.

portals.name: District Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar property-card service
portals.observation: Official district page links citizens to the property-card service. This is a record service, not evidence of open parcel-vector download.

portals.name: Maharashtra Government Gazette name-change notification
portals.operator: General Administration Department, Government of Maharashtra
portals.observation: Published copy of 24 February 2023 Gazette notification directs the city name Aurangabad to be changed to Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, confirming name continuity.

portals.name: Maharashtra Bhumi Abhilekh district office page
portals.observation: District-specific page identifies the District Superintendent of Land Records, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar; underlying service is state-operated.

requests.observation: Official portal content specifies entire-city mapping and digitized cadastral maps; status code not exposed. No full feature query was run.
Public map UI content loaded with layers/queries, but not a parcel feature-service response.

requests.method: Official government gazette PDF web inspection
requests.observation: Notification dated 24 February 2023 confirms city name-change from Aurangabad to Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar.

The live city map UI loaded with map layers, query, city property/ward tools and 2021–2026 imagery options. It did not expose a cadastral layer in the rendered layer chooser; the overview separately states that cadastral maps were digitized. No geometry request was made.

WMS GetCapabilities returned 94 named layers, including boundary/utility/building layers but no explicit parcel feature layer. Viewer static config points to this WMS; the related internal getGeoJsonData route is POST and was not invoked. No full geometry response was obtained.

requests.type: text/html with embedded public layer metadata
requests.observation: The embedded City GIS layer list contains no cadastral/parcel/City Survey Plot layer; its public-layer entries include landmarks and traffic islands. No feature attributes/geometries were requested.
App configuration declares dataProjection EPSG:32643, display projection EPSG:3857, public WMS URL, and surveyPortalUrl https://gis.chhsambhajinagarmc.org/ascdl_survey.
The official surveyPortalUrl returns Unauthorized without credentials. No login, account, or credential was attempted.

Generic GetGeoJSON wrapper POSTs WKT value, tableName, dataType, isTableData, and fid; no safe property allowlist or max-feature parameter is included in the app contract. The GeoJSON route was not called.
Spatial GeoJSON parser sets isTableData=false and fid=0 and expects EPSG:4326 GeoJSON for EPSG:3857 display. Actual endpoint payload CRS is unverified.

unresolved: Whether the separately protected survey portal offers eligible public parcel geometry, or whether a cadastral layer is selectively added to an authorized map view, remains unknown. No anonymous parcel vector layer, WUP-point parcel, or response CRS was verified. AppData declares EPSG:32643 data and EPSG:3857 map projections; the GeoJSON parser expects EPSG:4326, but the actual payload CRS was not observed.
nextStep: Seek an officially documented anonymous parcel-vector route, or an expressly public query contract with a small result cap and safe identifier-plus-geometry field selection. Do not authenticate to /ascdl_survey.
